subject.title: Feature Request: Surface API provider name in error/overload messages

question: Should OpenClaw expose provider/model/profile=active/trigger context in shared chat transient-error replies, or narrow the delivered copy to provider/model only?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the final user-visible context crosses shared-channel privacy and provider/auth metadata policy.

options.title: Provider/Model In Chat, Other Fields In Logs
options.body: Deliver provider/model to users and keep profile presence or trigger in lifecycle/log metadata unless maintainers explicitly approve wider shared-chat context.

options.title: Full Safe Context In Chat
options.body: Allow provider/model/profile=active/trigger in delivered transient-error replies after the refreshed PR proves raw identifiers stay hidden.

options.title: Pause Core Direction
options.body: Keep this open but do not land core copy changes until maintainers decide transient provider diagnostics should remain log-only or plugin-specific.

recommendation.title: Provider/Model In Chat, Other Fields In Logs
recommendation.body: Deliver provider/model to users and keep profile presence or trigger in lifecycle/log metadata unless maintainers explicitly approve wider shared-chat context.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest routing candidate for provider/auth behavior touched by the linked fix and adjacent authMode work.
